name: Cylindrical Container with Cover (Lian)
material: gilt bronze with openwork and chased designs
dimensions: Diameter: 16 cm (6 5/16 in.); Overall: 17.2 cm (6 3/4 in.)
summary: This magnificent gilded bronze vessel with openwork decoration shows all kinds of fabulous creatures, real and imaginary, chasing each other among swirling scrolls.
